sections.note: A scene makes the item appear in the event field; find it (the hint says where), then hand it over to unlock the Connection event.
rows: Flat Stone - Try looking for it on the walking trail.

A bunch of flat stones perfect for stone skipping.

These stones fit just right even for people with small hands.
Red Fruit - Try looking for it in the restaurant.

A round red fruit.

Looks like it belongs in a salad.
Fishing Net - Try looking for it at the hot spring.

An ordinary fishing net.

Looks perfect for catching fish.
Pen - Try looking for it in the dormitory.

A normal pen. Nothing special about it.

The ink is permanent, so use it cautiously.
Rabbit Mask - Try looking for it in the dormitory.

An old rabbit mask.

Looks like something that was used by children in some sort of celebration before.

This should be enough to cover one's face.
